subject: fixed XXH64_finalize() not being inlined
perf_evidence: Commit message says the finalizer is forced inline because GCC 11 had failed to inline it in XXH_INLINE_ALL mode.
change_summary: Changes XXH64_finalize from plain static to force-inline.

units.name: public XXH64 one-shot and streaming fixed-length matrix, four inline configurations
units.evidence: Nine fixed-length targets pass both directions under default hints; threshold and no-hints runs also pass the same targets.

units.name: public XXH64 one-shot with symbolic length
units.evidence: The symbolic-length target times out in both directions despite unroll 4.

units.name: Raw XXH64_finalize, all 32 tail residues and both alignments
units.precondition: valid tail bytes and 8-byte alignment when XXH_aligned
units.evidence: finalize-proof-audit.json: 64 bidirectional Alive2 checks, no IR loops

notes: The only source change is the XXH64_finalize inline annotation. The exact raw finalizer is proved for every len&31 residue, both alignments, and arbitrary initial hash/input bytes under valid-memory preconditions. Public symbolic-length API and GCC 11 codegen/performance remain unchecked.
